summary: The bad lattice set is finite, root-volume concavity excludes the distinguished lattice point from its convex hull, and the nearest-point construction yields a proper halfspace containing the distinguished point while avoiding every bad lattice point. The boundary-mass calculation, Grunbaum bound, fiberwise inequalities, degenerate fibers, and finite mixed-integer summation are all correct, and both cited external results apply in the stated forms.
